purpose: Pair magnitude and sign: B-C at rest, 1.5 apart, T=1, dt 0.0005. Fit the window t<=0.3 for each particle's acceleration (cubic fit, known initial state). Newton's third law (m_i a_i = -m_j a_j) gives mass ratios. Charge-product rule predicts |F_AB|^2 = |F_AA||F_BB| and |F_AC|^2 = |F_AA||F_CC| and |F_BC|^2 = |F_BB||F_CC|. Prediction: no P-0003 prediction (non-A pair). Falsified if the rank-one relation fails by more than the fit error.
